specs.title: at 320 px the shell is exactly viewport-wide and the site switcher, the Track AI launcher and the account menu stay inside it
at 375 px the shell is exactly viewport-wide and the site switcher, the Track AI launcher and the account menu stay inside it
at 768 px the shell is exactly viewport-wide and the site switcher, the Track AI launcher and the account menu stay inside it
below `sm` the command palette opens from the navigation drawer
the workspace switcher triggers and the account menu render a visible focus ring
keeps the shell exactly viewport-high with a 250-message conversation and windows the list
motion preference off produces no animated frame: the core reports the static tier
prefers-reduced-motion renders the static tier from the server on, without an animation flash
exposes the activity live region, the motion state and the setup workspace targets
serves all six programme locales
home renders with lang="en", one h1, self canonical, hreflang alternates for six locales + x-default and no serious accessibility violations
home renders with lang="de", one h1, self canonical, hreflang alternates for six locales + x-default and no serious accessibility violations

home renders with lang="it", one h1, self canonical, hreflang alternates for six locales + x-default and no serious accessibility violations
home renders with lang="nl", one h1, self canonical, hreflang alternates for six locales + x-default and no serious accessibility violations
unprefixed URLs redirect permanently to English and keep the query string
the language switcher leads to the same page in the other language

old blog URLs redirect permanently and directly to Tracking Knowledge, query string included
pricing never shows invented amounts: either Stripe prices or the honest empty state
legal pages carry the operator identity from the environment or state that it is missing
the sitemap index points to a pages and a knowledge sitemap per locale
